items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Lane's going badly. Sell it for your first counter or when slots fill.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Hotel Guest unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Rapid Recharge. Ultimate (Hotel Guest) is available from Rapid Recharge.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Call Bell (2 to 3).

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Call Bell (123) clears its 80-damage trigger; Luggage Cart stays under it.

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Call Bell: widens its radius.
items.why: imminent: Rapid Recharge completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Adds 1 more charge to Call Bell (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Guardian Ward, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Guardian Ward completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Guardian Ward completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-18,400 (levels 15-24). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Call Bell T3, Luggage Cart T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Call Bell, explosion damage) grows from 191 to 295. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Guardian Ward.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Guardian Ward completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Guardian Ward completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 15.5 to Call Bell's explosion damage (1.55x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 27.9 to Call Bell's explosion damage (1.55x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Call Bell (283) clears its 165-damage trigger. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Call Bell: takes 18% off its 18s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 46.5 to Call Bell's explosion damage (1.55x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 12,000 to 16,800 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 198s; 20% off is 39.6s per full rotation.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,800-44,800 (levels 28-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Hotel Guest T3.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 18,400 to 24,800 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Doorway doorway distance (65m), Call Bell radius (10m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.
sections.desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows that let them catch you.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: On Call Bell. Sell Opening Rounds for this.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Infuser
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Spirit Lifesteal for 4,800 more souls: tech resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Upgrade of Guardian Ward (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Guardian Ward. If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 198s of base cooldown across your kit, 120s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Greater Expansion: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
